verdict.rationale: AngelList is a SaaS platform that ships AI features such as the Tie Out Assistant, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of any setting, policy or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Account deletion, mentioned in community posts, is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
